description:
Search the KVK Handelsregister

Direct passthrough to the KVK Handelsregister Search API. Fields follow
KVK: `kvkNummer`, `vestigingsnummer`, `naam`, `adres.binnenlandsAdres`,
`type` (`rechtspersoon`/`hoofdvestiging`/`nevenvestiging`). Current data
is always fetched from KVK; the local search cache (48 hours) only serves
repeated queries within that window. `lastFetchedAt` shows the last
retrieval date.

Cost: 0.5 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: kvk.search
